$comment: lib/office-fonts/powerpoint-bullet-fallbacks.json: the face PowerPoint for Windows draws a list bullet in when the
bullet's own face lacks its character, and the advances it lays that bullet out by.
The rule is read from PowerPoint for Windows' own PDF and Slide.Export pictures (MRAI-corpus/office-truth/probes/
lf13-bufont, lf13-bufont2, 11-19: ten bullet characters, buSzPts 24, in 19 bullet faces), confirmed by its slideshow:
- the bullet's face draws it when it has the character (buFont, or the text's face under buFontTx);
- a face Windows lacks is drawn as Office draws it (Calibri whatever the theme, or Office's own pick);
- a character the face lacks is drawn, character by character, by the first of: Times New Roman behind a face whose
OS/2 panose serif style is not sans (Rockwell, Constantia, Perpetua, Georgia; embedded Bree Serif, Nunito Sans,
Oswald, all style 0, in Windows' PDFs of R417_04, R580_16, R549_10), Arial behind a sans one, style 11-15 (Tw Cen MT,
Gill Sans MT, Calibri; an embedded PT Sans Narrow, R523_01), then Cambria Math (every face's U+25C6), then Segoe UI
- at the bullet's own size (buSzPts / buSzPct): the fallback never changes it.
Not mapped: buFont Wingdings with a Unicode buChar (the slideshow draws a missing-glyph box for all but U+00BB).
